data.name: Barr
data.gender_notes: Barr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-r-r', meaning 'to wander, to travel'. This name holds spiritual significance as it symbolizes the journey of life and the constant pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name Barr carries the meaning “Sailor, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Barr usually hope their child will grow to embody sailor, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflecting the divine qualities of strength, courage, and nobility. Those named Barr are encouraged to live their lives with honor, integrity, and a strong sense of purpose.
data.etymology: Barr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sailor, Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barr total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta describes his visit to the city of Barr al-Rusud in present-day Libya, which was an important center of Islamic learning and scholarship during the Middle Ages.
